notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: lev is 'heart' rendered as bel per discipline — seat of feeling and will, not the organ

notes.subject: long taunbilo
notes.rationale: belat 'in secret/stealth' rendered as 'quietly/secretly' rather than literal 'covered'

notes.subject: ותגל
notes.rationale: galah means to uncover/denude; could be Ruth uncovering her own covering, but the object is his feet as marked

translation: Na Boas i kaikai pinis, na em i dring, na bel bilong em i kamap gutpela, na em i go long slip long kona bilong hap graun i bin katim katim i stap sanap; na em i kam insait long taunbilo, na em i rausim klos bilong lukautim liganleg bilong en, na em i slipdaun.

tokens.gloss: hap graun i bin katim katim i stap sanap
na em i rausim klos bilong
